_note: Non-secret AIO Tests sync conventions/mappings. Secrets (AIO_API_TOKEN, optional AIO_EMAIL) come from environment variables ONLY — never store a token here. Invoke the consumer's configured syncCases command; dry-run must remain the default. Authority: the installed sync-cases skill.

defaults._labels_doc: Each scenario's @testtype:<level> tag (unit/integration/api/component/e2e/contract/performance/security — the PROBE test-type classification) is pushed to the AIO case Labels field. Any entries here are merged into every case's Labels in addition to the per-scenario test type.

requirement._doc: Requirement link is derived from the PRD/requirements doc per feature: the first Jira issue key found in docs/PRDs/<feature>.md (excluding AC-/TC-/CAT- ids) is linked; otherwise the PRD title (or the slug) is used as a label. Override per feature via requirementMap.
